question: Explain how a neutral metal sphere can be charged negatively by induction using a positively charged rod. State the role of earthing.

options.A: Bring the positive rod near the sphere, remove the rod first, and then earth the sphere; electrons leave the sphere
options.B: Touch the sphere with the positive rod; electrons are transferred from the rod to the sphere
options.C: Bring the positive rod near the sphere, earth it so electrons flow from earth into the sphere, disconnect earth first, then remove the rod; the sphere retains excess electrons and becomes negative
options.D: Earth the positive rod instead of the sphere, then remove the earth connection
